bead.title: Validate ESF entity schemas before every pqueue write
bead.description: Compile QueueDefinition.entity_schema once per queue and validate typed item documents pre-commit. Cover push, batch push, upsert/replace pending, update_fields, and vectorized commit lifecycle_items. Rejection must happen before log append, idempotency recording, SQL mutation, or projection apply. In-scope files: engine command/write paths, memory/sqlite/postgres create/open queue state, projection validation hooks, pqueue facade tests. Out-of-scope: secondary index key replacement. Required behavior: schema-less queues remain byte-identical; typed queues reject malformed JSON with EngineError before any durable change; format assertions follow axon_esf CompiledSchema behavior.
bead.acceptance: cargo test -p pqueue schema_validation -- --nocapture passes; cargo test -p pqueue-conformance storage_conformance -- --nocapture passes; tests prove invalid push/update_fields/commit lifecycle item appends nothing and idempotency replay does not record failed writes.
